docs.publisher:
The leading organization token. Copublishers follow after a slash;
the whole tail captures as ONE scalar span ("/IEC/IEEE") because
the engine's array-group harvest pads non-firing reps with empty
hashes (parsanol-ruby#399) — the builder splits the span.
docs.copublishers:
At least one item: the optional around [copublishers] keeps the
key absent when the identifier has no copublisher (a zero-width
capture would bind an empty array, not a scalar span).
docs.part_modern_body:
number/part bodies inlined at every capture site so each capture
holds one scalar span; part_legacy's negative lookahead keeps a
"/Amd"-style tail from being read as a legacy slash part.
docs.nsb_iso_identifier:
#118: the stage-to-publisher join differs per branch — the Fpr form
glues onto the publisher, the WD form carries a slash. The slash
captures as nsb_stage_slash so the render emits the join per shape
(the Fpr branch binds nothing to join with).
docs.tc_document:
#118: the publisher-to-type join is "/" or a space per the input's
own spelling; it captures as tc_join so the render emits the
captured join back (a canonical slash would re-bind a space-joined
input to the other alternative's value).
docs.supplement_second_part_isor: ISO/R supplement layer second_part: isor_supp_* names.
docs.supplement_second_part: First supplement layer: /Amd 1:2021 after the base designation.
docs.supplement_second_part3: Third supplement layer (/Cor1:2014 riding a two-level chain): supp3_*.
docs.ballot_type_with_stage:
The DAM-family ballot token in TYPE position. Captured under its
own name: the supplement tables' captures stay reserved for the
on-base layers, and the ballot's stage is the one the decode keeps.
docs.ballot_stamp:
An on-base stamp riding a ballot face ("/Amd 9:2001", "/Amd.1",
"/Am1:2006"): it carries the amendment's number and ballot date
while its own token letters are decode-away (matched uncaptured —
the ballot's stage comes from the TYPE token). Mirrors the three
supplement tails: a (glued or spaced) number with an optional
date, or a dot number.
docs.ballot_supplement_identifier:
"ISO/IEC FDAM 1 14496-12:2004", "ISO/PDAM 19973-2": the ballot
token first, then the base kept whole. The TYPE-token number is
space-bounded on both sides — mandatory trailing space — so
"PDAM 19973-2" cannot read 19973 as the ballot number: with no
second space the group backtracks and 19973 parses in second_part.
docs.ballot_space_supplement_identifier:
The space-attached ballot face: "ISO 15877-5:2009 FDAM 1" — the
base designation first, then the ballot token attached by a space.
The base front is inlined (not supplement_base_no_third): that
rule ends in base_third_part_edition, whose own optional space
would consume the separator the ballot token needs. No base
edition is served here — none of the stored or owner-cited ballot
faces carries one.
docs.directives_supp_publisher: Non-bundled directives supplement (ISO/IEC DIR 1 ISO SUP): dsupp_*.
docs.directives_base_document:
Bundled directives ("DIR 1:2022 + IEC SUP:2022"): the base document
keeps the plain names, and each bundle item captures into its own
position-scoped prefix (bs1_* on the first, bs2_*/bs3_* on the
second and third). The engine's array-group harvest pads non-firing
reps with empty hashes (parsanol-ruby#399), so bundle items cannot
collect through an array binding; three items bound. The source
parser's 1* accepted any count — a fourth "+ SUP" item now fails
to parse rather than mis-bind.
docs.idf_supp_type_with_stage:
IDF supplement side of the joint (a true IDF supplement keeps its
fields under idf_supp_*2 names).
docs.identifier:
The ISO identifier root: common-text twin form first, then the
single spine. The historic ballot faces go last — purely additive
branches (an input an earlier member parses keeps that parse).

source:
# Pubid ISO flavor — port of lib/pubid/iso/parser.rb (pubid monorepo).
#
# Scope: the full identifier root — NSB stage prefixes (FprISO, WD/ISO),
# TC documents (ISO/TC 184/SC 4/WG 3 N 123), directives (plain,
# supplement, bundled "DIR 1 + IEC SUP"), JCGM, legacy ISO/R forms
# (including supplements), the three-level supplement chains
# (/Amd/../Cor/../Amd..), the copublisher identifier spine, and the
# joint "ISO x|IDF y" form. The IDF grammar is imported via `use idf`
# so the artifact exposes the idf.identifier entry beside identifier;
# the joint's IDF side itself is spelled with the inlined idf_* rules
# below, whose captures carry the idf_ prefix so they never collide
# with the ISO ones and can bind as scalars.
#
# Historic TYPE-first ballot faces (decode-to-modern, owner ruling
# 2026-11-12): the DAM-family token in TYPE position — "ISO/IEC FDAM 1
# 14496-12:2004", "ISO/PDAM 19973-2" — and the space-attached ballot
# face "ISO 15877-5:2009 FDAM 1". Both branches sit LAST in the
# identifier alternation, so they are purely additive: every face an
# earlier branch parses keeps its exact parse. The ballot token
# captures as ballot_type_with_stage; a number on the TYPE token is
# space-bounded (ballot_number) so "PDAM 19973-2" keeps 19973 in the
# base; an on-base stamp's number/date capture as ballot_stamp_* (the
# stamp token itself matches uncaptured — the ballot's stage comes
# from the TYPE token and the decode keeps no spelling). The builder
# folds the captures into ONE amendment layer over the whole base, the
# number taken from the TYPE token, the stamp, or the implied 1.
#
# Edition 2 with typed model bindings: every capture the builder
# consumes is bound. Supplement layers capture into position-scoped
# names (supp_* on the first supplement, supp2_* on the second,
# supp3_* on the third, isor_supp_* on an ISO/R supplement,
# dsupp_*/bs1_/bs2_/bs3_ on directive supplements, idf_*/idf_supp_* on the
# joint's IDF side): captures are collected globally by name, so shared
# names across layers would collapse the layer's number/date onto the
# base's. The base document's own edition is base_edition wherever a
# supplement layer's third_part can carry its own edition.

use idf

grammar PubidIso version "0.5.0" edition 2 {

  # ---- lexical (pubid/parser/common_parse_rules.rb + ISO override) ----
  digit = %x30-39
  digits = 1*digit
  letter = %x41-5A / %x61-7A
  lower = %x61-7A
  word_digit = %x30-39 / %x41-5A / %x61-7A
  word_char = %x30-39 / %x41-5A / %x61-7A / %x5F
  space = " "
  dash = "-" / "‑" / "‐"
  dot = "."
  slash = "/"
  colon = ":"

  century = "19" / "20"
  year_digits = century 2*digit !digit
  month_digits = 2*digit
  day_digits = 2*digit

  # ---- stage-abbreviation vocabularies (uncaptured; capture sites
  # inline the alt so the capture holds one scalar span) ----
  typed_stage_abbrev = alt from_table "typed_stages" column "abbr"
  supp_stage_abbrev = alt from_table "typed_stages_supplements" column "abbr"
  ballot_stage_abbrev = alt from_table "typed_stages_ballots" column "abbr"
  directives_stage_abbrev = alt from_table "directives_typed_stages" column "abbr"
  directives_supp_stage_abbrev = alt from_table "directives_supplements_typed_stages" column "abbr"
  idf_stage_abbrev = alt from_table "idf_typed_stages" column "abbr"
  idf_supp_stage_abbrev = alt from_table "idf_typed_stages_supplements" column "abbr"

  # ---- publishers and copublishers ----
  ## The leading organization token. Copublishers follow after a slash;
  ## the whole tail captures as ONE scalar span ("/IEC/IEEE") because
  ## the engine's array-group harvest pads non-firing reps with empty
  ## hashes (parsanol-ruby#399) — the builder splits the span.
  publisher = ("ISO" / "IEC") as publisher
  organization = alt from_table "organizations" column "name"
  ## At least one item: the optional around [copublishers] keeps the
  ## key absent when the identifier has no copublisher (a zero-width
  ## capture would bind an empty array, not a scalar span).
  copublishers = {
    (
      (slash [space] (alt from_table "organizations" column "name"))
      *(slash [space] (alt from_table "organizations" column "name"))
    ) as copublishers
  }
  prefix_sole_publisher = publisher
  prefix_with_copublishers = prefix_sole_publisher [space] [copublishers]

  # ---- number and parts ----
  ## number/part bodies inlined at every capture site so each capture
  ## holds one scalar span; part_legacy's negative lookahead keeps a
  ## "/Amd"-style tail from being read as a legacy slash part.
  part_modern_body = dash [space] 1*word_digit *(dash 1*word_digit)
  part_legacy_body = slash [space] !supp_stage_abbrev 1*word_digit
  number_with_part = {
    (
      (1*5digit)
      [
        (
          (dash [space] 1*word_digit *(dash 1*word_digit))
          / (slash [space] !supp_stage_abbrev 1*word_digit)
        )
      ]
    ) as number_with_part
  }

  # ---- stage iteration: "ISO 11243.1" ----
  stage_iteration = dot digit as stage_iteration

  # ---- date: ":2005-02", ":--", ":—", legacy dash form ----
  date_core = (("--" / "—")) as undated_marker / (("19" / "20") 2*digit !digit [(dash 2*digit)] [(dash 2*digit)]) as date
  date = (colon / dash) [date_core]

  second_part = {
    number_with_part
    [stage_iteration]
    [[space] date]
  }

  # ---- typed stages ----
  type_with_stage = {
    (
      (alt from_table "typed_stages" column "abbr")
    ) as type_with_stage
    [digit as stage_iteration space]
  }

  # ---- third part: edition, language, all-parts ----
  edition_body = ("Edition" / "Ed." / "ED" / "Ed") [space] [1*digit]
  edition = {
    (
      (("Edition" / "Ed." / "ED" / "Ed") [space] [1*digit])
    ) as edition
  }
  lang_word = 1*letter [","]
  # Separator-first: "(E/F)" and "(E,F)" only parse if each code item
  # claims its following separator before the bare-word alternative
  # commits (PEG ordered choice — parslet retries fewer iterations, PG
  # does not).
  lang_sep = slash / ","
  lang_code = %x45 / %x46 / %x41 / %x52 / %x44 / %x53
  languages = {
    (
      *( ((%x45 / %x46 / %x41 / %x52 / %x44 / %x53) [(slash / ",")]) / (1*letter [","]) )
    ) as languages
  }
  language = "(" languages ")"
  all_parts = "(all parts)" as all_parts
  third_part_edition = [space] [edition]
  third_part = third_part_edition [language] [space] [all_parts]

  # ---- guide prefix ----
  guide_prefix = "Guide" / "GUIDE"

  # ---- the copublisher identifier form ----
  identifier_copublishers_no_third = {
    [ (("Guide" / "GUIDE") as type_with_stage_fr) space ]
    [prefix_with_copublishers]
    [space]
    [slash]
    [type_with_stage]
    [space]
    second_part
    third_part_edition
  }
  identifier_copublishers = identifier_copublishers_no_third third_part

  # The supplement-base variant: identical, but the edition captures as
  # base_edition so the supplement layer's own third_part edition is the
  # top-level one.
  base_third_part_edition = {
    [space] [
      (
        (("Edition" / "Ed." / "ED" / "Ed") [space] [1*digit])
      ) as base_edition
    ]
  }
  supplement_base_no_third = {
    [ (("Guide" / "GUIDE") as type_with_stage_fr) space ]
    [prefix_with_copublishers]
    [space]
    [slash]
    [type_with_stage]
    [space]
    second_part
    base_third_part_edition
  }

  # ---- JCGM: "JCGM 200:2008(F)" ----
  jcgm_identifier = "JCGM" as publisher space second_part third_part

  # ---- NSB stage prefixes: "FprISO 105-A03", "WD/ISO 10360-5:2000" ----
  ## #118: the stage-to-publisher join differs per branch — the Fpr form
  ## glues onto the publisher, the WD form carries a slash. The slash
  ## captures as nsb_stage_slash so the render emits the join per shape
  ## (the Fpr branch binds nothing to join with).
  nsb_iso_identifier = {
    (
      ("Fpr" as nsb_stage) prefix_sole_publisher [space] [copublishers] [space] [type_with_stage] [space] second_part third_part
    )
    /
    (
      ("WD" as nsb_stage) (slash as nsb_stage_slash) prefix_sole_publisher [space] [copublishers] [space] [type_with_stage] [space] second_part third_part
    )
  }

  # ---- TC documents: "ISO/TC 184/SC 4/WG 3 N 123" ----
  tc_type = (alt from_table "tc_types" column "name") as tc_type
  wg_type = (alt from_table "wg_types" column "name") as wg_type
  sc_type = ("SC/QC" / "SC") as sc_type
  tc_subcommittee_part = {
    (
      slash sc_type space (1*digit) as sc_number slash wg_type space (1*digit) as wg_number
    )
    /
    (
      slash sc_type space (1*digit) as sc_number
    )
  }
  ## #118: the publisher-to-type join is "/" or a space per the input's
  ## own spelling; it captures as tc_join so the render emits the
  ## captured join back (a canonical slash would re-bind a space-joined
  ## input to the other alternative's value).
  tc_document = prefix_sole_publisher ((slash / space) as tc_join) tc_type space (1*digit) as tc_number [tc_subcommittee_part] space "N" [space] (1*digit) as number [(colon (("19" / "20") 2*digit !digit) as year)]
  bare_tc_document = {
    (1*digit) as tc_number
    slash sc_type space (1*digit) as sc_number
    [ slash wg_type space (1*digit) as wg_number ]
    space "N" [space] (1*digit) as number
    [(colon (("19" / "20") 2*digit !digit) as year)]
  }

  # ---- legacy ISO/R ----
  iso_r_prefix = ("ISO/R") as iso_r_prefix
  iso_r_identifier = iso_r_prefix space second_part third_part
  iso_r_supplement_separator = slash / ([space] "—" [space]) / (space dash space)
  iso_r_supplement_identifier = {
    iso_r_prefix space second_part
    iso_r_supplement_separator
    (
      (alt from_table "typed_stages_supplements" column "abbr")
    ) as isor_supp_type_with_stage
    [space] supplement_second_part_isor
    third_part
  }

  # ---- supplements (up to three levels) ----
  ## ISO/R supplement layer second_part: isor_supp_* names.
  supplement_second_part_isor = {
    (
      (
        (1*5digit)
        [
          (
            (dash [space] 1*word_digit *(dash 1*word_digit))
            / (slash [space] !supp_stage_abbrev 1*word_digit)
          )
        ]
      ) as isor_supp_number_with_part
    )
    [ dot digit as isor_supp_stage_iteration ]
    [
      [space] (
        (colon / dash) [
          (("19" / "20") 2*digit !digit [(dash 2*digit)] [(dash 2*digit)]) as isor_supp_date
          / (("--" / "—")) as isor_supp_undated_marker
        ]
      )
    ]
  }

  ## First supplement layer: /Amd 1:2021 after the base designation.
  supplement_second_part = {
    (
      (
        (1*5digit)
        [
          (
            (dash [space] 1*word_digit *(dash 1*word_digit))
            / (slash [space] !supp_stage_abbrev 1*word_digit)
          )
        ]
      ) as supp_number_with_part
    )
    [ dot digit as supp_stage_iteration ]
    [
      [space] (
        (colon / dash) [
          (
            (("19" / "20") 2*digit !digit [(dash 2*digit)] [(dash 2*digit)])
          ) as supp_date
          / (("--" / "—")) as supp_undated_marker
        ]
      )
    ]
  }
  supplement_type_with_stage = {
    (
      (alt from_table "typed_stages_supplements" column "abbr")
    ) as supp_type_with_stage
  }
  supp_date_tail = {
    (colon / dash) [
      (("19" / "20") 2*digit !digit [(dash 2*digit)] [(dash 2*digit)]) as supp_date
      / (("--" / "—")) as supp_undated_marker
    ]
  }
  supplement_identifier_no_third = {
    supplement_base_no_third
    slash supplement_type_with_stage
    [
      ( [space] supplement_second_part )
      / ( dot (1*digit) as supp_number )
      / ( [space] supp_date_tail )
    ]
  }
  supplement_identifier = supplement_identifier_no_third third_part

  ## Second supplement layer (/Amd1:2018/Cor1:2019): supp2_* names.
  supplement_second_part2 = {
    (
      (
        (1*5digit)
        [
          (
            (dash [space] 1*word_digit *(dash 1*word_digit))
            / (slash [space] !supp_stage_abbrev 1*word_digit)
          )
        ]
      ) as supp2_number_with_part
    )
    [ dot digit as supp2_stage_iteration ]
    [
      [space] (
        (colon / dash) [
          (("19" / "20") 2*digit !digit [(dash 2*digit)] [(dash 2*digit)]) as supp2_date
          / (("--" / "—")) as supp2_undated_marker
        ]
      )
    ]
  }
  supplement_type_with_stage2 = {
    (
      (alt from_table "typed_stages_supplements" column "abbr")
    ) as supp2_type_with_stage
  }
  supplement_third_part2_edition = {
    [space] [
      (
        (("Edition" / "Ed." / "ED" / "Ed") [space] [1*digit])
      ) as supp2_edition
    ]
  }
  language2 = "(" ( ( *( ((%x45 / %x46 / %x41 / %x52 / %x44 / %x53) [(slash / ",")]) / (1*letter [","]) ) ) as supp2_languages ) ")"
  supplement_third_part2 = {
    supplement_third_part2_edition
    [ (language2) ]
    [space]
    [ (("(all parts)")) as supp2_all_parts ]
  }
  supplement_supplement_identifier = {
    supplement_identifier_no_third
    slash supplement_type_with_stage2
    (
      ( [space] supplement_second_part2 supplement_third_part2 )
      / ( dot (1*digit) as supp2_number supplement_third_part2 )
    )
  }

  ## Third supplement layer (/Cor1:2014 riding a two-level chain): supp3_*.
  supplement_second_part3 = {
    (
      (
        (1*5digit)
        [
          (
            (dash [space] 1*word_digit *(dash 1*word_digit))
            / (slash [space] !supp_stage_abbrev 1*word_digit)
          )
        ]
      ) as supp3_number_with_part
    )
    [ dot digit as supp3_stage_iteration ]
    [
      [space] (
        (colon / dash) [
          (("19" / "20") 2*digit !digit [(dash 2*digit)] [(dash 2*digit)]) as supp3_date
          / (("--" / "—")) as supp3_undated_marker
        ]
      )
    ]
  }
  supplement_type_with_stage3 = {
    (
      (alt from_table "typed_stages_supplements" column "abbr")
    ) as supp3_type_with_stage
  }
  supplement_third_part3_edition = {
    [space] [
      (
        (("Edition" / "Ed." / "ED" / "Ed") [space] [1*digit])
      ) as supp3_edition
    ]
  }
  language3 = "(" ( ( *( ((%x45 / %x46 / %x41 / %x52 / %x44 / %x53) [(slash / ",")]) / (1*letter [","]) ) ) as supp3_languages ) ")"
  supplement_third_part3 = {
    supplement_third_part3_edition
    [ (language3) ]
    [space]
    [ (("(all parts)")) as supp3_all_parts ]
  }
  supplement_supplement_supplement_identifier = {
    supplement_supplement_identifier
    slash supplement_type_with_stage3
    (
      ( [space] supplement_second_part3 supplement_third_part3 )
      / ( dot (1*digit) as supp3_number supplement_third_part3 )
    )
  }

  # ---- historic TYPE-first ballot faces (decode-to-modern) ----
  ## The DAM-family ballot token in TYPE position. Captured under its
  ## own name: the supplement tables' captures stay reserved for the
  ## on-base layers, and the ballot's stage is the one the decode keeps.
  ballot_type_with_stage = {
    (
      (alt from_table "typed_stages_ballots" column "abbr")
    ) as ballot_type_with_stage
  }
  ## An on-base stamp riding a ballot face ("/Amd 9:2001", "/Amd.1",
  ## "/Am1:2006"): it carries the amendment's number and ballot date
  ## while its own token letters are decode-away (matched uncaptured —
  ## the ballot's stage comes from the TYPE token). Mirrors the three
  ## supplement tails: a (glued or spaced) number with an optional
  ## date, or a dot number.
  ballot_stamp = {
    slash supp_stage_abbrev
    (
      (
        [space]
        ((1*5digit)) as ballot_stamp_number
        [
          [space]
          (
            (colon / dash) [
              (("19" / "20") 2*digit !digit [(dash 2*digit)] [(dash 2*digit)]) as ballot_stamp_date
              / (("--" / "—")) as ballot_stamp_undated_marker
            ]
          )
        ]
      )
      / ( dot (1*digit) as ballot_stamp_dot_number )
    )
  }
  ## "ISO/IEC FDAM 1 14496-12:2004", "ISO/PDAM 19973-2": the ballot
  ## token first, then the base kept whole. The TYPE-token number is
  ## space-bounded on both sides — mandatory trailing space — so
  ## "PDAM 19973-2" cannot read 19973 as the ballot number: with no
  ## second space the group backtracks and 19973 parses in second_part.
  ballot_supplement_identifier = {
    prefix_with_copublishers
    [space]
    [slash]
    ballot_type_with_stage
    [ space ((1*digit)) as ballot_number space ]
    [space]
    [type_with_stage]
    [space]
    second_part
    [ ballot_stamp ]
  }
  ## The space-attached ballot face: "ISO 15877-5:2009 FDAM 1" — the
  ## base designation first, then the ballot token attached by a space.
  ## The base front is inlined (not supplement_base_no_third): that
  ## rule ends in base_third_part_edition, whose own optional space
  ## would consume the separator the ballot token needs. No base
  ## edition is served here — none of the stored or owner-cited ballot
  ## faces carries one.
  ballot_space_supplement_identifier = {
    [ (("Guide" / "GUIDE") as type_with_stage_fr) space ]
    [prefix_with_copublishers]
    [space]
    [slash]
    [type_with_stage]
    [space]
    second_part
    space ballot_type_with_stage
    [ space ((1*digit)) as ballot_number ]
  }

  # ---- directives: "ISO/IEC DIR 1", "ISO/IEC JTC 1 DIR", supplements,
  # bundled "ISO/IEC DIR 1:2022 + IEC SUP:2022" ----
  directives_publisher_subgroup = ("JTC 1") as subgroup
  directives_number_with_part = {
    (
      (1*5digit)
      [ (space ("ISO" / "IEC") !slash !(space "SUP")) ]
    ) as number_with_part
  }
  directives_identifier_no_third = {
    prefix_with_copublishers
    [space]
    [ (directives_publisher_subgroup) space ]
    (
      (alt from_table "directives_typed_stages" column "abbr")
    ) as type_with_stage
    [ space directives_publisher_subgroup !(space "SUP") ]
    [
      [space directives_number_with_part]
      [(colon date)]
    ]
  }
  directives_identifier = directives_identifier_no_third [third_part] [space] [date]

  ## Non-bundled directives supplement (ISO/IEC DIR 1 ISO SUP): dsupp_*.
  directives_supp_publisher = ("ISO/IEC" / "ISO" / "IEC" / "JTC 1") as dsupp_publisher
  dsupp_date_tail = {
    (colon / dash) [
      (("19" / "20") 2*digit !digit [(dash 2*digit)] [(dash 2*digit)]) as dsupp_date
      / (("--" / "—")) as dsupp_undated_marker
    ]
  }
  directives_supplement_part_no_third = {
    [ ([space] "--" [space] "Consolidated" space) ]
    directives_supp_publisher
    ( space (alt from_table "directives_supplements_typed_stages" column "abbr") as dsupp_type_with_stage )
    [ dsupp_date_tail ]
  }
  dsupp_third_part_edition = {
    [space] [
      (
        (("Edition" / "Ed." / "ED" / "Ed") [space] [1*digit])
      ) as dsupp_edition
    ]
  }
  dsupp_language = "(" ( ( *( ((%x45 / %x46 / %x41 / %x52 / %x44 / %x53) [(slash / ",")]) / (1*letter [","]) ) ) as dsupp_languages ) ")"
  directives_supplement_part = {
    directives_supplement_part_no_third
    dsupp_third_part_edition
    [ (dsupp_language) ]
    [space]
    [ (("(all parts)")) as dsupp_all_parts ]
  }
  directives_supplement_identifier = directives_identifier_no_third [space] directives_supplement_part

  ## Bundled directives ("DIR 1:2022 + IEC SUP:2022"): the base document
  ## keeps the plain names, and each bundle item captures into its own
  ## position-scoped prefix (bs1_* on the first, bs2_*/bs3_* on the
  ## second and third). The engine's array-group harvest pads non-firing
  ## reps with empty hashes (parsanol-ruby#399), so bundle items cannot
  ## collect through an array binding; three items bound. The source
  ## parser's 1* accepted any count — a fourth "+ SUP" item now fails
  ## to parse rather than mis-bind.
  directives_base_document = {
    directives_identifier_no_third
    [[third_part] [space]]
    [[date] [space]]
  }
  bs1_publisher = ("ISO/IEC" / "ISO" / "IEC" / "JTC 1") as bs1_publisher
  bs1_date_tail = {
    (colon / dash) [
      (("19" / "20") 2*digit !digit [(dash 2*digit)] [(dash 2*digit)]) as bs1_date
      / (("--" / "—")) as bs1_undated_marker
    ]
  }
  bundled_supplement1 = {
    "+ "
    [ ([space] "--" [space] "Consolidated" space) ]
    bs1_publisher
    ( space (alt from_table "directives_supplements_typed_stages" column "abbr") as bs1_type_with_stage )
    [ bs1_date_tail ]
  }
  bs2_publisher = ("ISO/IEC" / "ISO" / "IEC" / "JTC 1") as bs2_publisher
  bs2_date_tail = {
    (colon / dash) [
      (("19" / "20") 2*digit !digit [(dash 2*digit)] [(dash 2*digit)]) as bs2_date
      / (("--" / "—")) as bs2_undated_marker
    ]
  }
  bundled_supplement2 = {
    "+ "
    [ ([space] "--" [space] "Consolidated" space) ]
    bs2_publisher
    ( space (alt from_table "directives_supplements_typed_stages" column "abbr") as bs2_type_with_stage )
    [ bs2_date_tail ]
  }
  bs3_publisher = ("ISO/IEC" / "ISO" / "IEC" / "JTC 1") as bs3_publisher
  bs3_date_tail = {
    (colon / dash) [
      (("19" / "20") 2*digit !digit [(dash 2*digit)] [(dash 2*digit)]) as bs3_date
      / (("--" / "—")) as bs3_undated_marker
    ]
  }
  bundled_supplement3 = {
    "+ "
    [ ([space] "--" [space] "Consolidated" space) ]
    bs3_publisher
    ( space (alt from_table "directives_supplements_typed_stages" column "abbr") as bs3_type_with_stage )
    [ bs3_date_tail ]
  }
  directives_bundled_identifier = {
    directives_base_document
    bundled_supplement1
    [bundled_supplement2]
    [bundled_supplement3]
  }
  directives_identifiers = directives_bundled_identifier / directives_supplement_identifier / directives_identifier

  # ---- joint: "ISO 5537|IDF 26" — the IDF grammar's rules inlined
  # under idf_* names (captures must not collide with the ISO ones) ----
  idf_publisher = ("IDF") as idf_publisher
  idf_number_with_part = {
    (
      (1*5word_char)
      [ (dash [space] 1*word_char *1(dash 1*word_char)) ]
    ) as idf_number_with_part
  }
  idf_stage_iteration = dot digit as idf_stage_iteration
  idf_date = {
    (
      (
        (("19" / "20") 2*digit !digit)
        [(dash 2*digit)]
        [(dash 2*digit)]
      )
    ) as idf_date
  }
  idf_second_part = {
    idf_number_with_part
    [idf_stage_iteration]
    [space]
    [ (colon idf_date) ]
  }
  idf_language = {
    "(" (
      (
        *( 1*lower [","] / ((%x45 / %x46 / %x41 / %x52 / %x44 / %x53) [slash]) )
      ) as idf_languages
    ) ")"
  }
  idf_all_parts = ("(all parts)") as idf_all_parts
  idf_third_part = [space] [idf_language] [idf_all_parts]
  idf_type_with_stage = {
    (
      (alt from_table "idf_typed_stages" column "abbr")
    ) as idf_type_with_stage
    [digit as idf_stage_iteration space]
  }
  idf_identifier_publisher_no_third = {
    idf_publisher
    [space]
    [slash]
    [idf_type_with_stage]
    [space]
    idf_second_part
  }
  ## IDF supplement side of the joint (a true IDF supplement keeps its
  ## fields under idf_supp_*2 names).
  idf_supp_type_with_stage = {
    (
      (alt from_table "idf_typed_stages_supplements" column "abbr")
    ) as idf_supp_type_with_stage
  }
  idf_supp_number_with_part2 = {
    (
      (1*5word_char)
      [ (dash [space] 1*word_char *1(dash 1*word_char)) ]
    ) as idf_supp_number_with_part2
  }
  idf_supp_stage_iteration2 = dot digit as idf_supp_stage_iteration2
  idf_supp_date2 = {
    (
      (
        (("19" / "20") 2*digit !digit)
        [(dash 2*digit)]
        [(dash 2*digit)]
      )
    ) as idf_supp_date2
  }
  idf_supplement_identifier = {
    idf_identifier_publisher_no_third
    [space] slash [space]
    idf_supp_type_with_stage
    [space]
    idf_supp_number_with_part2
    [ dot digit as idf_supp_stage_iteration2 ]
    [
      [space] (
        (colon / dash) [
          (("19" / "20") 2*digit !digit [(dash 2*digit)] [(dash 2*digit)]) as idf_supp_date2
          / (("--" / "—")) as idf_supp_undated_marker
        ]
      )
    ]
    [space] [idf_language] [idf_all_parts]
  }
  joint_idf_identifier = idf_supplement_identifier / idf_identifier_publisher_no_third idf_third_part
  joint_identifier = {
    supplement_base_no_third
    [space] "|" [space]
    joint_idf_identifier
  }

  ## The ISO identifier root: common-text twin form first, then the
  ## single spine. The historic ballot faces go last — purely additive
  ## branches (an input an earlier member parses keeps that parse).
  identifier = {
      bare_tc_document
    / nsb_iso_identifier
    / tc_document
    / directives_identifiers
    / jcgm_identifier
    / iso_r_supplement_identifier
    / iso_r_identifier
    / supplement_supplement_supplement_identifier
    / supplement_supplement_identifier
    / supplement_identifier
    / joint_identifier
    / identifier_copublishers
    / ballot_space_supplement_identifier
    / ballot_supplement_identifier
  }

  entry identifier: identifier

  bindings identifier {
    publisher -> publisher (string)
    publisher -> publisher_name (string) preprocess: publisher_names
    copublishers -> copublishers (string)
    type_with_stage -> type_with_stage (string)
    type_with_stage_fr -> type_with_stage_fr (string)
    base_edition -> base_edition (string)
    nsb_stage -> nsb_stage (string)
    nsb_stage_slash -> nsb_stage_slash (string)
    iso_r_prefix -> iso_r_prefix (string)
    number_with_part -> number_with_part (string)
    stage_iteration -> stage_iteration (string)
    date -> date (string)
    undated_marker -> undated_marker (string)
    edition -> edition (string)
    languages -> languages (string)
    all_parts -> all_parts (string)
    year -> year (string)
    tc_type -> tc_type (string)
    tc_join -> tc_join (string)
    tc_number -> tc_number (string)
    sc_type -> sc_type (string)
    sc_number -> sc_number (string)
    wg_type -> wg_type (string)
    wg_number -> wg_number (string)
    number -> number (string)
    subgroup -> subgroup (string)
    supp_type_with_stage -> supp_type_with_stage (string)
    supp_number_with_part -> supp_number_with_part (string)
    supp_stage_iteration -> supp_stage_iteration (string)
    supp_number -> supp_number (string)
    supp_date -> supp_date (string)
    supp_undated_marker -> supp_undated_marker (string)
    supp2_type_with_stage -> supp2_type_with_stage (string)
    supp2_number_with_part -> supp2_number_with_part (string)
    supp2_stage_iteration -> supp2_stage_iteration (string)
    supp2_number -> supp2_number (string)
    supp2_date -> supp2_date (string)
    supp2_undated_marker -> supp2_undated_marker (string)
    supp2_edition -> supp2_edition (string)
    supp2_languages -> supp2_languages (string)
    supp2_all_parts -> supp2_all_parts (string)
    supp3_type_with_stage -> supp3_type_with_stage (string)
    supp3_number_with_part -> supp3_number_with_part (string)
    supp3_stage_iteration -> supp3_stage_iteration (string)
    supp3_number -> supp3_number (string)
    supp3_date -> supp3_date (string)
    supp3_undated_marker -> supp3_undated_marker (string)
    supp3_edition -> supp3_edition (string)
    supp3_languages -> supp3_languages (string)
    supp3_all_parts -> supp3_all_parts (string)
    isor_supp_type_with_stage -> isor_supp_type_with_stage (string)
    isor_supp_number_with_part -> isor_supp_number_with_part (string)
    isor_supp_stage_iteration -> isor_supp_stage_iteration (string)
    isor_supp_date -> isor_supp_date (string)
    isor_supp_undated_marker -> isor_supp_undated_marker (string)
    dsupp_publisher -> dsupp_publisher (string)
    dsupp_type_with_stage -> dsupp_type_with_stage (string)
    dsupp_date -> dsupp_date (string)
    dsupp_undated_marker -> dsupp_undated_marker (string)
    dsupp_edition -> dsupp_edition (string)
    dsupp_languages -> dsupp_languages (string)
    dsupp_all_parts -> dsupp_all_parts (string)
bs1_publisher -> bs1_publisher (string)
bs1_type_with_stage -> bs1_type_with_stage (string)
bs1_date -> bs1_date (string)
bs1_undated_marker -> bs1_undated_marker (string)
bs2_publisher -> bs2_publisher (string)
bs2_type_with_stage -> bs2_type_with_stage (string)
bs2_date -> bs2_date (string)
bs2_undated_marker -> bs2_undated_marker (string)
bs3_publisher -> bs3_publisher (string)
bs3_type_with_stage -> bs3_type_with_stage (string)
bs3_date -> bs3_date (string)
bs3_undated_marker -> bs3_undated_marker (string)
    idf_publisher -> idf_publisher (string)
    idf_type_with_stage -> idf_type_with_stage (string)
    idf_stage_iteration -> idf_stage_iteration (string)
    idf_number_with_part -> idf_number_with_part (string)
    idf_date -> idf_date (string)
    idf_languages -> idf_languages (string)
    idf_all_parts -> idf_all_parts (string)
    idf_supp_type_with_stage -> idf_supp_type_with_stage (string)
    idf_supp_number_with_part2 -> idf_supp_number_with_part2 (string)
    idf_supp_stage_iteration2 -> idf_supp_stage_iteration2 (string)
    idf_supp_date2 -> idf_supp_date2 (string)
    idf_supp_undated_marker -> idf_supp_undated_marker (string)
    ballot_type_with_stage -> ballot_type_with_stage (string)
    ballot_number -> ballot_number (string)
    ballot_stamp_number -> ballot_stamp_number (string)
    ballot_stamp_dot_number -> ballot_stamp_dot_number (string)
    ballot_stamp_date -> ballot_stamp_date (string)
    ballot_stamp_undated_marker -> ballot_stamp_undated_marker (string)
  }

  ## In-file grammar tests: run at compile time, embedded in the artifact,
  ## and re-runnable by every consumer (accept / reject / example with
  ## expected bound captures).
  test {
    accept "ISO 8601-1:2019"
    accept "ISO/IEC WD TS 25025"
    accept "ISO/WD Study 42010"
    accept "ISO/WDS 42010"
    accept "Guide ISO/CEI 51:1999"
    accept "ISO/IEC DIR 1:2022 + IEC SUP:2022"
    accept "184/SC 4/WG 12 N10291"
    accept "ISO 5537|IDF 26"
    accept "ISO 4055/Amd 1:2021"
    accept "ISO/R 9:1962"
    accept "ISO/IEC FDAM 1 14496-12:2004"
    accept "ISO/PDAM 19973-2"
    accept "ISO/IEC FPDAM 9075/1"
    accept "ISO/IEC FPDAM 10373-6/Amd 9:2001"
    accept "ISO/PDAM 19110:2005/Amd.1"
    accept "ISO/IEC PDAM TR 9573-11/Amd.1"
    accept "ISO/IEC PDAM 9541-1/Amd.4"
    accept "ISO/IEC PDAM 2 10646:2012"
    accept "ISO 15877-5:2009 FDAM 1"
    accept "ISO 19776-2:2005/Am1:2006"
    reject "nonsense"
    reject "ISO/PDAM"
    reject "ISO/FDAM"
    example "ISO/IEC WD TS 25025" { publisher: "ISO" }
    example "JCGM 200:2008(F)" { publisher: "JCGM" }
    example "ISO/IEC FDAM 1 14496-12:2004" {
      ballot_type_with_stage: "FDAM"
      ballot_number: "1"
      number_with_part: "14496-12"
      date: "2004"
    }
    example "ISO/PDAM 19973-2" {
      ballot_type_with_stage: "PDAM"
      number_with_part: "19973-2"
    }
    example "ISO/IEC FPDAM 10373-6/Amd 9:2001" {
      ballot_type_with_stage: "FPDAM"
      ballot_stamp_number: "9"
      ballot_stamp_date: "2001"
    }
    example "ISO/PDAM 19110:2005/Amd.1" {
      ballot_type_with_stage: "PDAM"
      ballot_stamp_number: "1"
    }
    example "ISO/IEC FPDAM 9075/1" {
      ballot_type_with_stage: "FPDAM"
      number_with_part: "9075/1"
    }
    example "ISO 15877-5:2009 FDAM 1" {
      ballot_type_with_stage: "FDAM"
      ballot_number: "1"
      number_with_part: "15877-5"
      date: "2009"
    }
    example "ISO/IEC FDAM 19776-2:2005/Am1:2006" {
      ballot_type_with_stage: "FDAM"
      ballot_stamp_number: "1"
      ballot_stamp_date: "2006"
    }
    # #118: the nsb_stage face — the Fpr branch glues onto the publisher,
    # the WD branch carries the captured slash (nsb_stage_slash).
    accept "FprISO 10140-4"
    accept "FprISO 13679"
    accept "FprISO/IEC 17029"
    accept "WD/ISO 10360-2"
    example "FprISO 105-A03" {
      nsb_stage: "Fpr"
      publisher: "ISO"
      number_with_part: "105-A03"
    }
    example "WD/ISO 10360-5:2000" {
      nsb_stage: "WD"
      nsb_stage_slash: "/"
      date: "2000"
    }
    # #118: the publisher-bearing tc_document face — the join captures as
    # tc_join, the type as tc_type (the bare-TC face binds neither).
    accept "ISO/TC 184/SC 4 N 789"
    accept "ISO/TC 184/SC/QC 4 N246"
    accept "ISO/TC 184 N 100"
    accept "ISO/TC 184 N 100:2024"
    accept "ISO TC 46 N 3064"
    example "ISO/TC 184/SC 4/WG 3 N 123" {
      tc_join: "/"
      tc_type: "TC"
      tc_number: "184"
      sc_number: "4"
      wg_number: "3"
      number: "123"
    }
    example "ISO TC 46 N 3064" {
      tc_join: " "
      tc_type: "TC"
      tc_number: "46"
      number: "3064"
    }
    example "ISO/JTC 1 N 456" {
      tc_join: "/"
      tc_type: "JTC"
      tc_number: "1"
      number: "456"
    }
  }
}

preprocess publisher_names {
  table_lookup iso_publishers abbrev -> name
}

derive urn "urn:iso:std:{number_with_part}:{date}"

# F6 render spec, #116: every bound field, in a join order that re-parses
# to the same bound map (the rs#459 round-trip oracle). The rules the
# segments obey, checked line-by-line against the identifier rules above:
#
# - The publisher joins the number with a SPACE (`prefix_sole_publisher =
#   publisher [space] ...`); the dash the old spec emitted is never
#   grammar-valid there. Shapes with no publisher at all (bare TC
#   documents, the ISO/R forms) render no prefix and no separator.
# - `copublishers` captures WITH its leading slash, so `publisher`
#   + `copublishers` needs no separator between them.
# - A typed stage after the prefix is joined with a space: the copublisher
#   spine accepts `[space] [slash] [type_with_stage]`, and the space form
#   re-parses to the same map for every stage-bearing shape ("ISO/WD Study
#   42010" renders as "ISO WD Study 42010" — the bound map is identical).
# - A ballot stage always renders slash-prefixed: the TYPE-first ballot
#   branch takes `[space] [slash] ballot_type_with_stage` after the
#   prefix, so "ISO/IEC PDAM 2 10646:2012" renders as
#   "ISO/IEC/PDAM 2 10646:2012" and re-parses through the same branch to
#   the same map; the space-attached ballot face re-parses through the
#   same branch too.
# - The ballot stamp's abbrev token is decode-away (matched uncaptured),
#   so the stamp renders the canonical "/Amd" spelling: the re-parse binds
#   stamp number/date only, and the abbrev spelling is not identity. The
#   dot-number stamp alternative is a different bound field
#   (ballot_stamp_dot_number), so the number renders in the spaced form.
# - Supplements join with "/" + the bound abbrev; the ISO/R supplement
#   layer takes the slash separator alternative of
#   iso_r_supplement_separator.
# - The joint renders " | " (the `[space] "|" [space]` join, house form).
# - The undated marker renders after its colon (`date = (colon / dash)
#   [date_core]`), and bare-TC documents keep the glued `N<number>` the
#   bare_tc_document rule accepts.
# - The NSB stage renders BEFORE the publisher, with the join its own
#   branch bound (#118): the Fpr branch binds no join face, so "FprISO
#   105-A03" renders glued ("FprISO 105-A03"); the WD branch captures the
#   slash as nsb_stage_slash, so "WD/ISO 10360-5:2000" renders
#   "WD/ISO 10360-5:2000". (The coded flavor decodes the NSB stage onto
#   the modern stage face — "ISO/PRF 105-A03" — which would re-bind a
#   different map; the render keeps the bound faces instead.)
# - The publisher-bearing tc_document face renders the join AS CAPTURED
#   (#118): a canonical slash would re-bind a space-joined input to the
#   other alternative, so `field tc_join` emits "/" or " " per the input.
#   The type follows space-joined (the rule's own `tc_type space`), then
#   the shared bare-TC cluster — "ISO/TC 184/SC 4/WG 3 N 123" renders as
#   "ISO/TC 184/SC 4/WG 3 N123", the glued N the cluster already uses
#   (spelling, not identity; the re-parse binds the identical map).
render default {
  cond nsb_stage {
    field nsb_stage
    cond nsb_stage_slash {
      field nsb_stage_slash
    }
  }
  cond type_with_stage_fr {
    field type_with_stage_fr
    literal " "
  }
  cond iso_r_prefix {
    field iso_r_prefix
  }
  cond publisher {
    field publisher
  }
  # #118: the tc_document face — the join renders as captured, the type
  # space-joined per the rule's own `tc_type space`. Neither face is
  # bound by any other spine, so the segments are inert everywhere else.
  cond tc_join {
    field tc_join
  }
  cond tc_type {
    field tc_type
    literal " "
  }
  cond copublishers {
    field copublishers
  }
  cond subgroup {
    literal " "
    field subgroup
  }
  cond tc_number {
    field tc_number
    # #118: the subcommittee tail is OPTIONAL on the publisher-bearing
    # tc_document face (the bare face always carries it), so the slash
    # rides on the SC's presence — "ISO/TC 184 N 100" renders without a
    # dangling "/".
    cond sc_type {
      literal "/"
      field sc_type
      literal " "
      field sc_number
      cond wg_type {
        literal "/"
        field wg_type
        literal " "
        field wg_number
      }
    }
    literal " N"
    field number
    cond year {
      literal ":"
      field year
    }
  }
  cond ballot_type_with_stage {
    literal "/"
    field ballot_type_with_stage
    cond ballot_number {
      literal " "
      field ballot_number
    }
  }
  cond type_with_stage {
    literal " "
    field type_with_stage
  }
  cond number_with_part {
    literal " "
    field number_with_part
  }
  cond stage_iteration {
    literal "."
    field stage_iteration
  }
  cond date {
    literal ":"
    field date
  }
  cond undated_marker {
    literal ":"
    field undated_marker
  }
  cond base_edition {
    literal " "
    field base_edition
  }
  cond ballot_stamp_number {
    literal "/Amd "
    field ballot_stamp_number
    cond ballot_stamp_date {
      literal ":"
      field ballot_stamp_date
    }
    cond ballot_stamp_undated_marker {
      literal ":"
      field ballot_stamp_undated_marker
    }
  }
  cond ballot_stamp_dot_number {
    literal "/Amd."
    field ballot_stamp_dot_number
  }
  cond supp_type_with_stage {
    literal "/"
    field supp_type_with_stage
    cond supp_number_with_part {
      literal " "
      field supp_number_with_part
    }
    cond supp_stage_iteration {
      literal "."
      field supp_stage_iteration
    }
    cond supp_number {
      literal "."
      field supp_number
    }
    cond supp_date {
      literal ":"
      field supp_date
    }
    cond supp_undated_marker {
      literal ":"
      field supp_undated_marker
    }
  }
  cond supp2_type_with_stage {
    literal "/"
    field supp2_type_with_stage
    cond supp2_number_with_part {
      literal " "
      field supp2_number_with_part
    }
    cond supp2_stage_iteration {
      literal "."
      field supp2_stage_iteration
    }
    cond supp2_number {
      literal "."
      field supp2_number
    }
    cond supp2_date {
      literal ":"
      field supp2_date
    }
    cond supp2_undated_marker {
      literal ":"
      field supp2_undated_marker
    }
  }
  cond supp3_type_with_stage {
    literal "/"
    field supp3_type_with_stage
    cond supp3_number_with_part {
      literal " "
      field supp3_number_with_part
    }
    cond supp3_stage_iteration {
      literal "."
      field supp3_stage_iteration
    }
    cond supp3_number {
      literal "."
      field supp3_number
    }
    cond supp3_date {
      literal ":"
      field supp3_date
    }
    cond supp3_undated_marker {
      literal ":"
      field supp3_undated_marker
    }
  }
  cond isor_supp_type_with_stage {
    literal "/"
    field isor_supp_type_with_stage
    cond isor_supp_number_with_part {
      literal " "
      field isor_supp_number_with_part
    }
    cond isor_supp_stage_iteration {
      literal "."
      field isor_supp_stage_iteration
    }
    cond isor_supp_date {
      literal ":"
      field isor_supp_date
    }
    cond isor_supp_undated_marker {
      literal ":"
      field isor_supp_undated_marker
    }
  }
  cond idf_publisher {
    literal " | "
    field idf_publisher
    cond idf_type_with_stage {
      literal "/"
      field idf_type_with_stage
    }
    cond idf_stage_iteration {
      literal "."
      field idf_stage_iteration
    }
    cond idf_number_with_part {
      literal " "
      field idf_number_with_part
    }
    cond idf_date {
      literal ":"
      field idf_date
    }
    cond idf_languages {
      literal "("
      field idf_languages
      literal ")"
    }
    cond idf_all_parts {
      literal " "
      field idf_all_parts
    }
  }
  cond edition {
    literal " "
    field edition
  }
  cond languages {
    literal "("
    field languages
    literal ")"
  }
  cond all_parts {
    literal " "
    field all_parts
  }
  cond dsupp_publisher {
    literal " "
    field dsupp_publisher
    literal " "
    field dsupp_type_with_stage
    cond dsupp_date {
      literal ":"
      field dsupp_date
    }
    cond dsupp_undated_marker {
      literal ":"
      field dsupp_undated_marker
    }
    cond dsupp_edition {
      literal " "
      field dsupp_edition
    }
    cond dsupp_languages {

      field dsupp_languages

    }
    cond dsupp_all_parts {
      literal " "
      field dsupp_all_parts
    }

  cond bs1_publisher {
    literal " + "
    field bs1_publisher
    literal " "
    field bs1_type_with_stage
    cond bs1_date {
      literal ":"
      field bs1_date

    cond bs1_undated_marker {

  cond bs2_publisher {

    field bs2_publisher
    literal " "

    cond bs2_date {
